sex: self-reported sex at birth of the participant, F = female, M = male, O = other
handedness: self-reported handedness (e.g., writing hand) of the participant

ear2ear.Description: distance between the tragus-helix intersection of the two ears, passing through the vertex

nas2in.Description: distance between the nasion and inion, passing through the vertex

rmt.Description: resting motor threshold for the FDI muscle, using the 5/10 relative frequency method, MEP peak-to-peak within 10-50ms >0.05mV

amt.Description: active motor threshold for the FDI muscle during finger movement (pegboard task), using the mean average of 5 potentials, with peak-to-peak amplitude within 10-50ms > ~ 0.1mV

m1lat.Description: distance between the vertex and the M1-FDI site, measured laterally, left = negative, right = positive

m1ant.Description: distance between the vertex and the M1-FDI site, measured anteriorly, posterior = negative, anterior = positive

smglat.Description: distance between the vertex and the SMG site, measured laterally, left = negative, right = positive

smgant.Description: distance between the vertex and the SMG site, measured anteriorly, posterior = negative, anterior = positive
